title: Saturday bake
note: A short invented chat. The scored spellings sit in the turns a summary replaces. The held-back spelling sits only in the kept tail.

messages.content: The Saturday bake has to finish before the stall opens at the market.
The levain goes in at 21:00 the night before, and the loaf bakes at 230 C.
Keep the shop name as Hearth & Rye. Flour Child was a bad joke.
Hearth & Rye it is. I am setting the stand mixer aside, and the dough is mixed by hand.
The beech peel is in bay 3.
